description: Search the registry by words: components, conventions, AI instruction sets and releases. Start here when you do not know the exact name of what you want; use mzizi_get_component once you have a component's name. A component hit with `rustCrate` has a Mzizi Roots (Rust) implementation, which is the lead; at an equal score it ranks first. Documentation pages are searched by the docs_* tools. Paged: up to 50 hits per call and at most 25000 characters; meta.has_more and meta.next_offset say how to get the rest.

offset.description: Hits to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from the previous call.

query.description: Free-text search term, e.g. 'button' or 'date picker'. Every word must match.

name: mzizi_search
title: Search Mzizi
